title.narrative: Climate Adaptation Planning

description.narrative: GGGI is supporting the National Adaptation Planning (NAP) process for the State of Qatar to enable the country to identify and address its medium- and long-term priorities for adapting to climate change as part of Qatar’s broader development strategy and post-pandemic recovery efforts. A key component of the process is conducting evidence-based, participatory, and expert-guided climate risk assessment to identify and prioritize the most urgent impacts of climate change on the most vulnerable sectors of the economy. These will serve as the basis for designing and implementing the appropriate adaptation measures to address the risks.

This initiative aims to: (1) reduce the vulnerability of Qatar to the impacts of climate change by enhancing its adaptative capacity and overall climate resilience; and (2) mainstream climate change adaptation into the broader development planning process in different sectors and levels.
